scope: Only exact11 role-office evidence and directly bound files. Mechanical byte/object/membership equality, not semantic approval, source promotion, runtime admission, current eligibility measurement or provider authority.
hash_recipe: SHA256 raw file bytes; object bodies use UTF-8 JSON sorted keys, compact separators, ensure_ascii=False, no trailing newline. Existing opaque census cluster identifiers are checked by exact retained row/member reference; no undocumented cluster-ID algorithm is inferred.

limits: No public web re-fetch or raw remote-body verification. The evidence explicitly retains parsed-text references rather than original remote bytes.
No Git checkout-head audit, semantic evidence appraisal, project import, runtime helper, test, preparation, provider/Zenodo/AquaDocs request, credential access, or repository edit.
Exact frozen historical payload equality is not a claim that those payloads are newly prepared or currently admitted.
